briefs.title_zh: 量子能生态 RWA周报 · 2026年11月27日
briefs.title_en: Quantum Energy & RWA Weekly Brief · 27 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周信号集中在“结算与标准基础设施”和“量子电网算法真机验证”两端。RWA 侧，瑞士央行 11 月 24 日联合 UBS、SIX、苏黎世州银行等启动“瑞士金融账本”探索项目（明确不代表将推出或发行代币化央行货币），瑞士联邦委员会 11 月 25 日批准 57 个加密资产信息自动交换伙伴辖区（2028 年起）；欧央行 11 月 24 日发布《代币化参考模型》供欧洲代币化标准组使用；香港金管局 11 月 25 日正式推出 CMU 数字资产平台，支持债券代币化与 24 小时多币种 DvP 结算，并计划扩展至基金与现实世界资产；美国 OKXICE 代币化证券交易场所 11 月 23 日依 SEC“创新豁免”上线，首批确认 113 项资产。量子能源侧，本源量子、东南大学与国电南瑞的量子电磁暂态仿真方法在“本源悟空-180”上以 2 个量子比特完成真机验证（论文刊于 IEEE Transactions on Sustainable Energy）；11 月 24 日武汉量子论坛发布十大量子应用场景，含量子电流互感器入网测试与光量子雷达风电功率预测。聚变侧以工程与供应链为主：英国 STEP 授出 684 万英镑回旋管设计合同，Proxima Fusion 首块仿星器径向板完成制造，田纳西州首笔 IRIS 补助 580 万美元投向氚增殖材料。本周仍未见经核实的大型能源资产 RWA 新发行。
briefs.summary_en: This week's signals concentrate on settlement and standards infrastructure, and on live-hardware validation of quantum algorithms for the grid. On the RWA side, the Swiss National Bank on 24 November launched a Swiss Financial Ledger exploration project with UBS, SIX, Zürcher Kantonalbank and others (explicitly not a decision to launch the ledger or to issue tokenised central-bank money); the Federal Council on 25 November approved 57 partner jurisdictions for automatic exchange of crypto-asset information (from 2028); the ECB on 24 November released a Tokenisation Reference Model for the European Tokenisation Standards Group; the Hong Kong Monetary Authority on 25 November formally launched the CMU Digital Asset Platform, supporting bond tokenisation and 24-hour multi-currency DvP settlement, with plans to extend to funds and real-world assets; and the US OKXICE tokenised-securities venue went live on 23 November under an SEC "innovation exemption", with 113 assets confirmed in the first batch. On the quantum-energy side, a quantum electromagnetic-transient simulation method from Origin Quantum, Southeast University and NARI was validated on Origin Wukong-180 with 2 qubits (paper in IEEE Transactions on Sustainable Energy); the Wuhan Quantum Forum on 24 November released ten quantum application scenarios, including grid-connection testing of a quantum current transformer and photonic-radar wind-power forecasting. Fusion this week was mainly engineering and supply chain: the UK STEP programme awarded a £6.84 million gyrotron design contract, Proxima Fusion completed manufacture of the first stellarator radial plate, and Tennessee's first IRIS grant of $5.8 million went to tritium-breeding materials. No verified large new energy-asset RWA issuance was found this week.

briefs.title_zh: 文明大学国际教育周报 · 2026年11月27日
briefs.title_en: Civilization University · International Education Weekly Brief · 27 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周国际教育有四条主线。第一，中英教育合作重启：时隔九年，中英教育部长磋商会暨中英教育峰会于11月24–25日在北京举行，双方签署《关于加强教育领域合作的协议》，覆盖高等教育、跨境教育、数字与人工智能等九大领域，并设立数字教育、STEM 基础教育、职业教育三个工作组；利物浦大学同期宣布与河北工业大学、中国海洋大学、南方医科大学、天津大学的四项新跨境办学合作。第二，AI 重塑大学教学与资源配置：EPFL 推进 s’ÉPanouir-FLourish 课程改革，并获选为 XPRIZE 首个欧洲大陆创新枢纽（五年 750 万瑞郎）；美国礼来基金会（Lilly Endowment）向印第安纳州 35 所高校批出合计 2.9171 亿美元的“高等教育 AI”实施资助。第三，留学政策“松紧并存”：美国法院相继否决或冻结限制留学生停留期限与 CPT 实习的新规，但 OPT 收费规则仍在审议；加拿大维持每年 15 万新增国际学生的目标；韩国拟将打工与毕业后居留资格与韩语水平挂钩。第四，量子与前沿科技人才培养走向国家与国际项目：印度首个“量子—AI 大学”过渡校区在古恩图尔启用，12月1日开课；纽约大学阿布扎比分校获美国国务院资助，启动 30 名阿联酋与美国研究生参与的月球探测仪器培养项目。
briefs.summary_en: International education this week has four main threads. First, China–UK education cooperation has restarted: after nine years, a China–UK education ministers' consultation and education summit were held in Beijing on 24–25 November. The two sides signed an Agreement on Strengthening Cooperation in Education, covering nine areas including higher education, cross-border education, and digital and artificial intelligence, and established three working groups on digital education, STEM basic education and vocational education. The University of Liverpool in the same period announced four new transnational-education partnerships with Hebei University of Technology, Ocean University of China, Southern Medical University and Tianjin University. Second, AI is reshaping university teaching and resource allocation: EPFL is advancing the s’ÉPanouir-FLourish curriculum reform and has been selected as XPRIZE's first innovation hub on the European continent (7.5 million Swiss francs over five years); the Lilly Endowment in the United States approved a total of $291.71 million in "AI in Higher Education" implementation grants for 35 institutions in Indiana. Third, study-abroad policy is tightening and loosening at once: US courts have successively vacated or frozen new rules limiting international students' duration of stay and CPT internships, but an OPT-fee rule is still under review; Canada is keeping a target of 150,000 new international students a year; South Korea plans to tie work and post-graduation residence rights to Korean-language proficiency. Fourth, talent training in quantum and frontier technology is moving into national and international programmes: India's first "quantum–AI university" transitional campus has opened in Guntur, with classes starting on 1 December; NYU Abu Dhabi, with US State Department funding, has launched a lunar-exploration instrument training programme for 30 Emirati and American graduate students.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因周报 · 2026年11月27日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Weekly Brief · 27 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周八条要闻围绕三条主线：“人群级基因组走向临床预测”“生殖与胚胎遗传技术突破”“量子计算切入基因组与药物发现”。中国昌平实验室、北京大学谢晓亮院士团队在《自然·生物医学工程》发表无创胚胎植入前遗传检测技术，220 个可报告致病等位基因诊断与活检对照全部一致。美国方面，Regeneron 遗传学中心在 Nature 发表 140 万人身高罕见变异研究，华盛顿大学与 Amgen 团队在 Nature 发表冠心病单细胞“变异—增强子—基因”图谱；Heng Li 等发布 Phirefly 预印本，首次在 D-Wave 与 IBM 量子硬件上执行长读长单倍型定相的关键步骤。欧洲方面，马普所在 Science 报道人工“染色体胶水”TALhesin 修复衰老卵子黏连缺陷；英国 Wellcome Sanger 研究所启动 Healthcare Genomics 预测医学项目；Qubit Pharmaceuticals、索邦大学与 Q-CTRL 在 IBM Heron 上完成蛋白口袋水合位点预测。以色列 Clalit 以 AI 问卷向 120 万女性提供乳腺癌风险评估。
briefs.summary_en: This week's eight items follow three threads: population-scale genomics moving into clinical prediction; breakthroughs in reproductive and embryonic genetic technology; and quantum computing entering genome analysis and drug discovery. The team of academician Xie Xiaoliang at Changping Laboratory and Peking University published in Nature Biomedical Engineering a non-invasive preimplantation genetic testing method; all 220 reportable pathogenic-allele diagnoses agreed with biopsy controls. In the United States, the Regeneron Genetics Center published in Nature a study of rare height variants in 1.4 million people, and a Washington University and Amgen team published in Nature a single-cell "variant–enhancer–gene" map of coronary artery disease. Heng Li and colleagues posted a Phirefly preprint, the first algorithm to run key steps of chromosome-scale haplotype phasing on D-Wave and IBM quantum hardware. In Europe, the Max Planck Institute reported in Science that an artificial "chromosome glue", TALhesin, repairs cohesion defects in aged eggs; the Wellcome Sanger Institute launched its Healthcare Genomics predictive-medicine programme; and Qubit Pharmaceuticals, Sorbonne University and Q-CTRL predicted hydration sites in protein pockets on an IBM Heron processor. Israel's Clalit is offering AI-questionnaire breast-cancer risk assessments to 1.2 million women.

briefs.title_zh: 量子能生态 RWA周报 · 2026年11月20日
briefs.title_en: Quantum Energy & RWA Weekly Brief · 20 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周最重要的信号来自聚变与代币化基础设施两端。聚变侧，日本经济产业省（METI）聚变发电示范补助正式定档：Starlight Engine（11 月 19 日）获最高 233 亿日元、Helical Fusion（11 月 18 日）获最高约 192 亿日元（约 1.26 亿美元）；法国 11 月 16 日发布 2026–2035 国家聚变战略，ITER 理事会 11 月 18–19 日确认 9 个真空室扇区模块已有 6 个就位。量子能源侧，国网浙江电科院研发的全国首套量子磁测电缆巡检装置 11 月 20 日首次用于 25.7 公里低频海缆巡检，用时约 1 天；美国能源部 11 月 17 日就低温与“量子-超算融合”测试平台征询意见（12 月 17 日截止）。RWA 侧，新加坡金管局 11 月 19 日公布已用批发型央行数字货币原生发行 1 亿新元代币化 MAS 票据，并发布 Guardian 代币化抵押品框架；香港金管局 11 月 16 日与 Swift 深化 Ensemble 跨境代币化存款合作；德国 DZ BANK 11 月 17 日经欧央行 Pontes 以央行货币结算 NRW.BANK 的以太坊代币化证券。本周未见经核实的大型能源资产 RWA 新发行。
briefs.summary_en: The most important signals this week come from fusion and from tokenisation infrastructure. On the fusion side, Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) formally set its fusion power-demonstration subsidies: Starlight Engine (19 November) is to receive up to 23.3 billion yen, and Helical Fusion (18 November) up to about 19.2 billion yen (about $126 million). France released a 2026–2035 national fusion strategy on 16 November, and the ITER Council on 18–19 November confirmed that 6 of 9 vacuum-vessel sector modules are in place. On the quantum-energy side, the first quantum magnetic-sensing cable-inspection device developed by State Grid Zhejiang Electric Power Research Institute was used on 20 November for the first time to inspect a 25.7 km low-frequency submarine cable, taking about one day; the US Department of Energy issued a request for information on 17 November on cryogenic and "quantum–HPC integration" testbeds (closing 17 December). On the RWA side, the Monetary Authority of Singapore announced on 19 November that it had natively issued S$100 million of tokenised MAS bills settled in wholesale central-bank digital currency, and released the Guardian tokenised-collateral framework; the Hong Kong Monetary Authority deepened Ensemble cooperation with Swift on 16 November on cross-border tokenised deposits; and Germany's DZ BANK on 17 November settled NRW.BANK ethereum-tokenised securities in central-bank money via the ECB's Pontes. No verified large new energy-asset RWA issuance was found this week.

briefs.title_zh: 文明大学国际教育周报 · 2026年11月20日
briefs.title_en: Civilization University · International Education Weekly Brief · 20 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周国际教育有四条主线。第一，美国年度数据落地：IIE《Open Doors 2026》（11月16日）显示 2025/26 学年在美国际生 1,146,163 人，同比下降约 3%，新生下降 18%、硕士生下降 22%，而博士生增长 3%；800 余所高校的 2026 秋季快照显示总数再降 9%。同周联邦法官对 DHS 收紧 CPT 实习的两份备忘录发出初步禁令。第二，全球流动“东移西减”：Studyportals/NAFSA/牛津英语测试联合调查显示，“四大”目的地 62% 的高校研究生国际招生下降，其他地区仅 27%，亚洲与欧洲大陆受益；爱尔兰则因签证拒签增加损失逾 800 万欧元学费收入。第三，AI 与量子成为大学组织与资源配置核心：ETH Zurich 决定自 2027 年起将 ETH AI Center、Quantum Center 等七个中心升级为“战略 ETH 中心”；FIU 与 IonQ 签约在校内部署 256 量子比特离子阱量子计算机；Caltech 获 6,750 万美元冠名计算与数学科学系，宾州州立大学获 7,500 万美元累计承诺。第四，跨学科与亚洲崛起：THE 跨学科科学排名 2027（11月18日）中 NUS 升至第 2、港大升至并列第 7，前十首次有三所亚洲大学；北航全球合作伙伴峰会在杭州揭牌三个国际科研平台；卡塔尔联合 Scale AI 与卡塔尔大学推出教育 AI 国家项目。
briefs.summary_en: International education this week has four main threads. First, annual US data landed: IIE's Open Doors 2026 (16 November) shows 1,146,163 international students in the United States in 2025/26, down about 3% year on year, with new students down 18% and master's students down 22%, while doctoral students rose 3%. A fall 2026 snapshot from more than 800 institutions shows a further 9% drop in the total. In the same week a federal judge issued a preliminary injunction against two DHS memoranda tightening CPT internships. Second, global mobility is "shifting east, shrinking in the west": a joint Studyportals/NAFSA/Oxford Test of English survey found that 62% of universities in the "big four" destinations saw a drop in international graduate enrolment, against only 27% elsewhere, with Asia and continental Europe benefiting; Ireland, meanwhile, has lost more than €8 million in tuition revenue because of more visa refusals. Third, AI and quantum have become central to university organisation and resource allocation: ETH Zurich has decided that from 2027 seven centres, including the ETH AI Center and the Quantum Center, will be upgraded to "Strategic ETH Centres"; FIU has signed with IonQ to deploy a 256-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer on campus; Caltech received $67.5 million to name its computing and mathematical sciences department, and Penn State received $75 million in cumulative pledges. Fourth, interdisciplinarity and Asia's rise: in THE Interdisciplinary Science Rankings 2027 (18 November), NUS rose to 2nd and the University of Hong Kong to joint 7th, with three Asian universities in the top ten for the first time; Beihang University's global partner summit in Hangzhou inaugurated three international research platforms; Qatar, with Scale AI and Qatar University, launched national education-AI projects.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因周报 · 2026年11月20日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Weekly Brief · 20 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周八条要闻围绕三条主线：“基因编辑的安全与监管”“AI 制药资本狂潮”“衰老测量与干预走向人群”。中国上海市公布上海交大医学院基因编辑研究致儿童死亡事件调查结果，首席研究者被免职，Nature 随后跟进报道；与此同时，Intellia 在 ACAAI 2026 公布体内 CRISPR 疗法 lonvo-z 四年随访数据，有望成为首个获 FDA 批准的体内基因编辑疗法。Salk 研究所在 Nature Methods 发表 Superb-seq，可在单细胞层面同时捕获 Cas9 的脱靶编辑及其对基因表达的影响。资本方面，Isomorphic Labs 完成 50 亿美元 C 轮融资。衰老领域，UC San Diego 在 Cell Metabolism 报道百岁老人肠道菌群代谢特征并以工程菌改善老年小鼠代谢；香港大学团队在 npj Aging 发表中国人群器官特异性蛋白质组衰老时钟 20 年随访结果。量子方面，Moth 在 IBM 120 比特处理器上编码并读回 DNA/蛋白序列数据；中东方面，迪拜宣布建立 Dubai Precision Medicine Centre。
briefs.summary_en: This week's eight items follow three threads: the safety and regulation of gene editing; a surge of capital into AI drug discovery; and ageing measurement and intervention moving toward populations. Shanghai published the findings of its investigation into a gene-editing study at Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine that led to a child's death; the principal investigator was dismissed, and Nature later followed the story. Meanwhile, Intellia presented four-year follow-up data for the in vivo CRISPR therapy lonvo-z at ACAAI 2026; it could become the first FDA-approved in vivo gene-editing therapy. The Salk Institute published Superb-seq in Nature Methods, which can capture Cas9 off-target edits and their effects on gene expression in the same single cell. On the capital side, Isomorphic Labs closed a $5 billion Series C. In ageing research, UC San Diego reported in Cell Metabolism on metabolic features of the gut microbiota in centenarians and used engineered bacteria to improve metabolism in old mice; a University of Hong Kong team published in npj Aging a 20-year follow-up of organ-specific proteomic ageing clocks in a Chinese population. On the quantum side, Moth encoded and read back DNA and protein sequence data on an IBM 120-qubit processor. In the Middle East, Dubai announced the establishment of a Dubai Precision Medicine Centre.

briefs.title_zh: 量子能生态 RWA周报 · 2026年11月13日
briefs.title_en: Quantum Energy & RWA Weekly Brief · 13 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周最重要的是权威基准与采购信号：国际原子能机构（IAEA）11 月 12 日在维也纳发布《World Fusion Outlook 2026》，引用私营聚变公司截至 2026 年 7 月的 12 个月融资创纪录约 45 亿美元、2021 年以来累计超 140 亿美元；同日英国 STEP 项目启动最高 1.15 亿英镑的五大系统采购。量子能源侧，中国南方电网公开招标“基于量子计算的电力市场出清模拟研究”（最高限价 277.5 万元，明确用光量子真机验证）；德国 BMFTR 资助约 400 万欧元的 QUANDA 项目，用离子阱量子计算做能源异常检测；同时一篇 Scientific Reports 同行评审论文显示，混合量子算法在 5–13 台机组的电网优化算例上（模拟）未优于随机采样，TU Delft 的 17 比特真机潮流演示也印证了规模与噪声限制。RWA 侧，欧洲央行、欧盟委员会与 ESMA 公开征集“欧洲代币化标准小组”（ETSG）成员，截止 11 月 27 日；香港 EX.IO 与 ZoneLink 签约推进日本光伏电站与数据中心 RWA。
briefs.summary_en: The most important signals this week are an authoritative benchmark and a procurement move. On 12 November the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) released World Fusion Outlook 2026 in Vienna, citing record private fusion financing of about $4.5 billion in the 12 months to July 2026 and more than $14 billion since 2021. The same day, the UK STEP programme launched procurement of five major systems, worth up to £115 million. On the quantum-energy side, China Southern Power Grid issued a public tender for "power-market clearing simulation research based on quantum computing" (a ceiling of 2.775 million yuan, with explicit validation on photonic quantum hardware); Germany's BMFTR is funding the QUANDA project at about €4 million, using trapped-ion quantum computing for energy anomaly detection; and a peer-reviewed Scientific Reports paper shows that a hybrid quantum algorithm did not beat random sampling on grid-optimisation cases of 5–13 generating units (in simulation), while a 17-qubit live-hardware power-flow demonstration at TU Delft also illustrated limits of scale and noise. On the RWA side, the European Central Bank, the European Commission and ESMA issued a public call for members of a European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG), closing on 27 November; Hong Kong's EX.IO and ZoneLink signed an agreement to advance RWAs of Japanese solar plants and data centres.

briefs.title_zh: 文明大学国际教育周报 · 2026年11月13日
briefs.title_en: Civilization University · International Education Weekly Brief · 13 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周国际教育有三条主线。第一，留学流动政策继续分化：美国国土安全部（DHS）拟向高校收取每次首次 OPT 推荐 7 万美元、后续推荐 3 万美元费用，意见征集期内美国总统联盟与密歇根大学于 11 月 9–10 日正式提交反对意见；与此同时，Studyportals 数据显示美国中期选举后（11 月 1–8 日）国际生对美国校园项目的页面浏览量上升 40%。在澳大利亚国际教育大会（AIEC）上，加拿大转向研究型研究生（2026 年二季度研究生新签学习许可 6,455 份，同比翻倍以上），新西兰追求增长，澳大利亚则在审议更严格的资金证明规则。第二，瑞士在 AI 教育与 AI×科学计算上双线发力：EPFL 11 月 12 日宣布 2027–28 学年开设 AI 本科学位；同日 ETH Zurich 与 EPFL 共获三项 ERC Synergy 大额资助，聚焦 AI 加速超算、混合精度算法（涵盖量子化学模拟）。第三，量子人才培养下沉到技术员和本科阶段：UCSB 获约 99.4 万美元建设量子技术员实训课程，FAU 获美国劳工部 300 万美元打造量子传感与通信人才通道；中国方面，北京大学发起的“数智教育发展国际大学联盟”在 2026 北京论坛期间与岭南大学签约，中白大学联盟第四次全体大会 11 月 11 日在上海举行。慈善方面，新墨西哥大学获估值 5,500 万美元遗产捐赠（校史最大），乔治梅森大学获 3,000 万美元设立两所政策研究院。
briefs.summary_en: International education this week has three main threads. First, study-abroad policy continues to diverge: the US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) proposes to charge universities $70,000 for each first OPT recommendation and $30,000 for each later one; during the comment period the Presidents' Alliance and the University of Michigan formally submitted objections on 9–10 November. At the same time, Studyportals data show that page views of US on-campus programmes by international students rose 40% in 1–8 November, after the midterm elections. At the Australian International Education Conference (AIEC), Canada is shifting toward research graduate students (6,455 new graduate study permits in the second quarter of 2026, more than double the same period a year earlier), New Zealand is pursuing growth, and Australia is considering stricter financial-evidence rules. Second, Switzerland is pushing on both AI education and AI × scientific computing: EPFL announced on 12 November an undergraduate AI degree from the 2027–28 academic year; the same day ETH Zurich and EPFL together received three large ERC Synergy awards, focused on AI-accelerated supercomputing and mixed-precision algorithms (including quantum-chemistry simulation). Third, quantum talent training is moving down to the technician and undergraduate level: UCSB received about $994,000 to build hands-on courses for quantum technicians, and FAU received $3 million from the US Department of Labor for a talent pathway in quantum sensing and communications. In China, the International University Alliance for the Development of Digital and Intelligent Education, initiated by Peking University, signed with Lingnan University during the 2026 Beijing Forum, and the fourth general assembly of the China–Belarus University Alliance was held in Shanghai on 11 November. In philanthropy, the University of New Mexico received a bequest valued at $55 million (the largest in its history), and George Mason University received $30 million to establish two policy institutes.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因周报 · 2026年11月13日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Weekly Brief · 13 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周八条要闻集中在“基因编辑走向注册与常见病”“AI 读懂细胞内的 DNA”“量子计算进入蛋白尺度”三条主线。Beam 的碱基编辑疗法 risto-cel 在镰状细胞病关键试验中达到主要终点，计划最早年底向 FDA 递交首个碱基编辑上市申请；CRISPR Therapeutics 的体内编辑疗法 CTX310 在 AHA 2026 公布 1b 期数据，单疗程使重度高甘油三酯血症患者甘油三酯平均下降 63%。Google DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2，可按细胞类型预测变异效应；芝加哥大学团队在 Nature Aging 报道矿物补充剂硫酸氧钒可选择性清除衰老细胞并延长雄性小鼠寿命。量子方面，克利夫兰诊所、RIKEN 与 IBM 完成 12,635 原子蛋白—配体量子—经典混合计算（预印本），欧洲 LRZ、IQM、UCL 等团队以量子+超算+AI 模拟蛋白切割。阿联酋批准 2026–2031 国家基因组总体规划，Emirati Genome Program 已达 100 万参与者；Nature Medicine 评论呼吁为中国高风险基因编辑研究者发起试验增设独立外部审查。
briefs.summary_en: This week's eight items centre on three threads: gene editing moving toward registration and common disease; AI reading DNA inside cells; and quantum computing reaching protein scale. Beam's base-editing therapy risto-cel met its primary endpoint in a pivotal sickle cell trial and plans to file the first base-editing marketing application with the FDA as early as the end of the year. CRISPR Therapeutics presented phase 1b data for the in vivo editing therapy CTX310 at AHA 2026: a single course cut triglycerides by an average of 63% in people with severe hypertriglyceridaemia. Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, which can predict variant effects by cell type. A University of Chicago team reported in Nature Aging that the mineral supplement vanadyl sulfate can selectively clear senescent cells and extend lifespan in male mice. On the quantum side, Cleveland Clinic, RIKEN and IBM completed a 12,635-atom protein–ligand hybrid quantum-classical calculation (a preprint), and Europe's LRZ, IQM, UCL and others simulated protein cleavage with quantum computing, supercomputing and AI. The UAE approved a 2026–2031 national genome master plan, and the Emirati Genome Program has reached 1 million participants. A Nature Medicine commentary called for an added layer of independent external review for high-risk investigator-initiated gene-editing trials in China.

briefs.title_zh: 量子能生态 RWA周报 · 2026年11月6日
briefs.title_en: Quantum Energy & RWA Weekly Brief · 6 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周量子能源侧出现两条可验证的应用进展：欧洲 IQM 与大众集团创新部门把量子–经典辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（QC-AFQMC）用于锂空气电池相关化学，50 轨道基准上经典后处理加速最高约 124 倍，并在 IQM Emerald 真机验证；中国方面，深港联合团队把国产相干光量子计算机嵌入广东电力市场仿真，回测平均绝对误差较传统方法降低超 20%。聚变侧，美国能源部 INFUSE 计划宣布 850 万美元资助 28 个公私合作项目；日德峰会期间多家聚变企业签署供应链 MoU（含藤仓高温超导带材与激光聚变合作）。RWA 侧，香港金管局将 Ensemble TX 试点推进到代币化央行货币 7×24 银行间结算，证监会在金融科技周明确“从铺轨转向造流量”；瑞士 SEALSQ 与 Eco Wave Power 演示可再生能源可信数字孪生与自动交易；代币化 ETF/ETP 规模截至 11 月 2 日约 6.87 亿美元。
briefs.summary_en: This week brought two verifiable application advances on the quantum-energy side. In Europe, IQM and Volkswagen Group Innovation applied quantum-classical auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (QC-AFQMC) to chemistry relevant to lithium-air batteries, with classical post-processing sped up by up to about 124 times on a 50-orbital benchmark, and validated the work on IQM's Emerald hardware. In China, a Shenzhen-Hong Kong team embedded a domestic coherent photonic quantum computer in a Guangdong power-market simulation, cutting mean absolute error on back-tests by more than 20% versus conventional methods. On the fusion side, the US Department of Energy's INFUSE programme announced $8.5 million for 28 public-private projects, and several fusion companies signed supply-chain MoUs around a Japan-Germany summit (including Fujikura high-temperature superconducting tape and laser-fusion cooperation). On the RWA side, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority took the Ensemble TX pilot to 24/7 interbank settlement in tokenised central-bank money, and the SFC said at FinTech Week that the focus was shifting "from laying tracks to generating traffic"; Switzerland's SEALSQ and Eco Wave Power demonstrated a trusted digital twin of renewable generation and automated trading; tokenised ETF/ETP assets were about $687 million as of 2 November.

briefs.title_zh: 文明大学国际教育周报 · 2026年11月6日
briefs.title_en: Civilization University · International Education Weekly Brief · 6 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周国际教育有三条主线。第一，跨境办学（TNE）正在从“补充通道”变成英语国家高校的主策略：University World News 11 月 4 日分析指出，英国 2024–25 学年跨境教育学生（约 69.97 万）首次超过在英国际生（约 68.14 万）；与此同时，英国预算文件对毕业签证“部分转向”——高合规、就业结果好的高校可保留两年签证，其他高校拟缩至 18 个月，引发“双轨制”与按邮编而非表现筛选的批评。第二，量子教育与产业转化继续机构化：韩国延世大学 11 月 4 日在仁川松岛部署全球首台由大学自营的 IBM Nighthawk r2 处理器，并与剑桥大学技术转化机构 Cambridge Enterprise 于 11 月 6 日揭牌亚洲首个 Leaf 合作枢纽；美国乔治梅森大学同日宣布主导 NSF 百万美元“量子计算×医疗”双专才培养项目。第三，中英高校在南京以“AI 时代高等教育”为主题发布共同倡议；美国迈阿密大学 Farmer 家族基金会承诺十年内向商学院捐赠最高 1 亿美元，并设 2,500 万美元配捐池。
briefs.summary_en: International education this week has three main threads. First, transnational education (TNE) is moving from a supplementary channel to a core strategy for universities in English-speaking countries: an analysis in University World News on 4 November notes that in 2024–25, UK transnational-education students (about 699,700) for the first time exceeded international students in the UK (about 681,400). At the same time, UK budget documents show a "partial shift" on the graduate visa — institutions with high compliance and strong employment outcomes may keep a two-year visa, while others would be cut to 18 months — prompting criticism of a "two-track" system and of screening by postcode rather than performance. Second, quantum education and industrial translation continue to become more institutional: Yonsei University in South Korea on 4 November deployed the first university-operated IBM Nighthawk r2 processor, at its Songdo campus in Incheon, and on 6 November inaugurated Asia's first Leaf partnership hub with Cambridge University's technology-transfer body Cambridge Enterprise; George Mason University in the United States announced the same day that it would lead a $1 million NSF programme to train dual specialists in "quantum computing × healthcare". Third, Chinese and British universities issued a joint initiative in Nanjing on "higher education in the AI era"; the Farmer Family Foundation pledged up to $100 million over ten years to Miami University's business school, including a $25 million matching pool.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因周报 · 2026年11月6日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Weekly Brief · 6 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周七条要闻贯穿“人群基因组与调控图谱扩容”和“编辑疗法/衰老干预落地”。德国基尔大学团队在 Nature Genetics 发布基于 490,319 名 UK Biobank 参与者的单倍型参考面板，东亚与南亚填补精度提升最大；葡萄牙 i3S 与罗切斯特大学在 Nature Communications 报道 KIF2C 小分子激动剂可增强 DNA 双链断裂修复并延长早衰小鼠健康寿命与寿命；英国 MHRA 将 CRISPR 疗法 Casgevy 适用年龄下调至 5 岁。卡塔尔生物银行在 Nature Genetics 发布中东近亲婚配人群转录组 QTL 目录（1,882 人）；斯坦福/Enable Medicine 团队发布空间多组学整合模型 CORAL；耶鲁团队在 Nature Methods 推出可保留三维基因组结构的单细胞表观成像技术 Epi-PHR；中科院上海营养与健康所 XChrom 用 AI 跨细胞预测染色质可及性。
briefs.summary_en: This week's seven items run through the expansion of population-genome and regulatory atlases, and the move of editing therapies and ageing interventions toward use. A Kiel University team published in Nature Genetics a haplotype reference panel based on 490,319 UK Biobank participants, with the largest imputation gains in East and South Asian groups. Portugal's i3S and the University of Rochester reported in Nature Communications that a small-molecule KIF2C agonist can enhance DNA double-strand-break repair and extend healthspan and lifespan in progeria mice. The UK MHRA lowered the eligible age for the CRISPR therapy Casgevy to 5 years. Qatar Biobank published in Nature Genetics a transcriptome QTL catalogue for a Middle Eastern consanguineous population (1,882 people). A Stanford / Enable Medicine team released the spatial multi-omics integration model CORAL. A Yale team introduced Epi-PHR in Nature Methods, a single-cell epigenomic imaging method that preserves 3D genome structure. XChrom, from the Shanghai Institute of Nutrition and Health, CAS, uses AI to predict chromatin accessibility across cells.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年11月2日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 2 November 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本期（周一，覆盖上周五至今）五条要闻聚焦“人群基因组基础设施升级”与“基因组稳定性对抗衰老”。德国基尔大学 Andre Franke 团队在 Nature Genetics 发布基于 490,319 名 UK Biobank 参与者全基因组测序构建的单倍型参考面板，相位与填补精度在多数全球人群优于 TOPMed r3，东亚、南亚人群提升最大；葡萄牙 i3S 研究所联合美国罗切斯特大学在 Nature Communications 报道，KIF2C 小分子激动剂可增强 DNA 双链断裂修复，并延长早衰症小鼠的健康寿命与寿命；英国 MHRA 将 CRISPR 疗法 Casgevy 的适用年龄从 12 岁下调至 5 岁；中国科学院上海营养与健康研究所发布深度学习模型 XChrom，把基因组序列与单细胞转录组结合预测跨细胞染色质可及性；美国 Setara Biosciences 完成 9,000 万美元 A 轮，推进罕见遗传病精准药物。
briefs.summary_en: This edition (Monday, covering last Friday to today) has five items focused on upgrades to population-genome infrastructure and on genome stability as a counter to ageing. Andre Franke's team at Kiel University published in Nature Genetics a haplotype reference panel built from whole-genome sequencing of 490,319 UK Biobank participants; phasing and imputation accuracy beat TOPMed r3 in most global populations, with the largest gains in East and South Asian groups. Portugal's i3S institute and the University of Rochester reported in Nature Communications that a small-molecule KIF2C agonist enhances DNA double-strand-break repair and extends healthspan and lifespan in progeria mice. The UK MHRA lowered the eligible age for the CRISPR therapy Casgevy from 12 to 5 years. The Shanghai Institute of Nutrition and Health, Chinese Academy of Sciences, released the deep-learning model XChrom, which combines genomic sequence with single-cell transcriptomes to predict chromatin accessibility across cell types. Setara Biosciences in the United States closed a $90 million Series A to advance precision medicines for rare genetic diseases.

briefs.title_zh: 量子能生态 RWA周报 · 2026年10月30日
briefs.title_en: Quantum Energy & RWA Weekly Brief · 30 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周量子能源的重点是“电网优化上真机”：美国 EPB × IonQ 在 NIST 400 万美元资助下，于本地 IonQ 系统上验证三种配电网重构算法，最大规模 417 节点；E.ON × Qoro × 英国 NQCC 把需 1,710 个量子比特的电网问题拆成最多 50 量子比特的子问题，在 IBM 硬件上跑通点对点能源交易调度。两者都坦承仍是概念验证、端到端速度尚未全面超越经典方法。中国方面，新华网报道合肥虚拟电厂以“5G+量子加密”调度，接入分布式能源超 1,450 兆瓦。聚变方面，美国商务部以 CHIPS 法案向 Helion（1.75 亿美元）和 CFS（8,500 万美元）发放半导体研发资金并换取无投票权股份；Proxima Fusion 与京都聚变工程签署 MoU。RWA 方面，DTCC 代币化服务 10 月 28 日正式上线，20 家参与机构已签约；香港证监会批准全球首个代币化公募基金在持牌平台上 7×24 二级交易。
briefs.summary_en: This week's focus in quantum energy is grid optimisation on real hardware. EPB × IonQ, with $4 million of NIST funding, validated three distribution-network reconfiguration algorithms on a local IonQ system, at a maximum scale of 417 nodes. E.ON × Qoro × the UK's NQCC split a grid problem that would need 1,710 qubits into subproblems of at most 50 qubits and ran peer-to-peer energy-trading scheduling on IBM hardware. Both sides acknowledge that this is still a proof of concept and that end-to-end speed does not yet fully beat classical methods. In China, Xinhua reported that Hefei's virtual power plant uses "5G + quantum encryption" for dispatch and has connected more than 1,450 MW of distributed energy. In fusion, the US Department of Commerce, under the CHIPS Act, awarded semiconductor R&D funds to Helion ($175 million) and CFS ($85 million) in exchange for non-voting shares. Proxima Fusion signed an MoU with Kyoto Fusioneering. On the RWA side, DTCC's tokenization service officially went live on 28 October, with 20 participant firms already signed up, and the Hong Kong SFC approved the world's first tokenised public funds for 24/7 secondary trading on a licensed platform.

briefs.title_zh: 文明大学国际教育周报 · 2026年10月30日
briefs.title_en: Civilization University · International Education Weekly Brief · 30 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周国际教育有三条主线。第一，中国把“境外办学”正式摆上台面：10 月 29 日中国国际教育年会首次设立境外办学专题论坛，教育部国际司代表提出倡导“小而美、惠民生、轻资产”模式，正在修订《高等学校境外办学指南》，并探索建立境外办学年报制度。第二，瑞士重返 Erasmus+ 再获一票：国民院科学教育文化委员会（WBK-N）10 月 22–23 日以 17 比 8 建议通过 2027 年拨款，国民院全体会议预计 12 月表决；同一周，EPFL 所在的 EuroTech 大学联盟 10 月 28 日在布鲁塞尔举行峰会，主题是把前沿技术转化为欧洲竞争力与技术主权。第三，量子与 AI 教育走向“机构化”：新加坡管理大学 10 月 27 日与量子计算公司 QpiAI 签约，师生可使用 64 量子比特的 Kaveri 量子计算机；印度确定在阿马拉瓦蒂建设首个“量子与 AI 大学校区”，五年投入 73.07 亿卢比。与此同时，美国 OPT 收费提案的意见征询将于 11 月 9 日截止，新西兰 10 月 27 日起收紧学生签证，英语国家对国际学生的吸引力继续承压；美国高校捐赠则继续流向“动手实训空间 + 人才培养”。
briefs.summary_en: International education this week has three main threads. First, China has formally put "running schools abroad" on the agenda: on 29 October the China Annual Conference for International Education held its first special forum on overseas campuses; a representative of the Ministry of Education's Department of International Cooperation and Exchange advocated a "small but excellent, people-centred, asset-light" model, said the Guidelines for Higher Education Institutions Running Schools Abroad were being revised, and that an annual reporting system for overseas campuses was being explored. Second, Switzerland's return to Erasmus+ gained another vote: the National Council's Committee for Science, Education and Culture (WBK-N) on 22–23 October recommended approval of 2027 funding by 17 votes to 8, with a plenary vote expected in December; in the same week, the EuroTech Universities Alliance, of which EPFL is a member, held a summit in Brussels on 28 October on turning frontier technology into European competitiveness and technological sovereignty. Third, quantum and AI education are becoming more institutional: Singapore Management University signed with quantum-computing company QpiAI on 27 October, giving faculty and students access to the 64-qubit Kaveri quantum computer; India has confirmed construction of its first "quantum and AI university campus" in Amaravati, with 7.307 billion rupees over five years. At the same time, public comment on the US OPT-fee proposal closes on 9 November, New Zealand tightened student visas from 27 October, and English-speaking countries' attractiveness to international students remains under pressure; US university gifts continue to flow toward hands-on training space and talent development.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年10月30日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 30 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本期五条要闻聚焦“体细胞基因组如何随时间改变大脑与衰老”与“AI 药物开发资本加速”。美国 Broad 研究所等在 Cell 发表研究，证实亨廷顿病致病 CAG 重复在新皮质神经元中同样随年龄扩增、超过约 150 次后致毒，提示正在研发的“抑制重复扩增”药物可能同时保护多个脑区；波士顿儿童医院 Christopher Walsh 团队在 Nature 报道，约 25.9% 的胎儿皮层神经元携带广泛拷贝数变异，出生后这一比例下降约 4.5 倍，揭示人脑发育中的“基因组质控”；McGill 大学、美国 Children's Mercy 医院与京都大学等在 Nature Communications 用长读长测序追踪 75 个家庭三人组的端粒遗传，父母端粒长度可解释子代端粒长度变异的 62.3%；美国 Formation Bio 设立 6 亿美元“药物开发加速器”基金；欧洲 AI 药物发现公司 ALLOX 完成 1,050 万美元种子轮。本期未检索到可核实的中国区重大新进展。
briefs.summary_en: This edition has five items focused on how somatic genomes change the brain and ageing over time, and on faster capital for AI drug development. A Cell paper from the Broad Institute and others shows that the pathogenic CAG repeat in Huntington's disease also expands with age in neocortical neurons and becomes toxic after about 150 repeats, suggesting that drugs in development to suppress repeat expansion may protect more than one brain region. A Nature paper from Christopher Walsh's team at Boston Children's Hospital reports that about 25.9% of fetal cortical neurons carry extensive copy-number variation, a share that falls about 4.5-fold after birth, revealing genomic quality control in human brain development. McGill University, Children's Mercy Hospital in the United States and Kyoto University used long-read sequencing in Nature Communications to trace telomere inheritance in 75 family trios; parental telomere length explained 62.3% of variation in offspring telomere length. Formation Bio in the United States set up a $600 million "drug development accelerator" fund. European AI drug-discovery company ALLOX closed a $10.5 million seed round. This edition found no verifiable major new developments from China.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年10月29日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 29 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本期五条要闻聚焦“群体规模基因组学把疾病风险落到具体细胞”与“新一代编辑工具和 AI 资本”。Nature 发表迄今最大阿尔茨海默病多祖源 GWAS（荷兰阿姆斯特丹自由大学牵头），新增 48 个风险位点，SNP 遗传力估计升至 16%；澳大利亚 Garvan 研究所等发布 TenK10K 一期，以 1,925 人、540 万个免疫细胞绘制单细胞层面的常见与罕见变异调控图谱；美国密歇根大学在 Nature Genetics 发布 287 份人体骨骼肌活检的单核多组学遗传调控图谱；南开大学团队在 Nature Methods 报道 MARRS RNA 编辑系统，不需外源酶即可在小鼠体内实现最高 84% 编辑效率；北京 AI 制药公司百奥几何（BioGeometry）A 轮系列累计融资超 1 亿美元。
briefs.summary_en: This edition has five items focused on population-scale genomics placing disease risk in specific cells, and on next-generation editing tools and AI capital. A Nature paper reports the largest multi-ancestry Alzheimer's GWAS to date (led by Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam), adding 48 risk loci and raising the SNP-heritability estimate to 16%. Australia's Garvan Institute and partners released phase 1 of TenK10K, mapping common and rare variant regulation at single-cell resolution in 1,925 people and 5.4 million immune cells. The University of Michigan published in Nature Genetics a single-nucleus multi-omic genetic-regulation atlas from 287 human skeletal-muscle biopsies. A Nankai University team reported in Nature Methods the MARRS RNA-editing system, which reaches up to 84% editing efficiency in mice without an exogenous enzyme. Beijing AI drug company BioGeometry has raised more than $100 million in cumulative Series A funding.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年10月28日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 28 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本期五条要闻聚焦“体内基因编辑的风险与监管”和“AI 与多组学重塑研发与衰老评估”。辉大基因在 Cell 发表杜氏肌营养不良症体内基因编辑 HG302 首次人体试验，4 名患儿中可见编辑与抗肌萎缩蛋白表达，但 1 名高剂量患儿因治疗相关急性呼吸窘迫综合征死亡；美国 FDA 同日发布个体化基因编辑产品 BLA 指南草案，允许在“个体化特征空间”内新增患者专属变体而无需新临床试验；瑞士 Atlas Bio 以 1,250 万美元总融资走出隐身，用约 200 万份人体 RNA 数据训练的 AI 模型做虚拟临床试验；Geromedicine 研究发现 17 种血浆蛋白与老年人全因死亡及器官生物年龄相关；韩国济州基因组计划发布 5,307 人基因组与表型队列。
briefs.summary_en: This edition has five items focused on the risks and regulation of in vivo gene editing, and on AI and multi-omics reshaping R&D and ageing assessment. HuidaGene published in Cell the first-in-human trial of HG302, an in vivo gene-editing therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy: editing and dystrophin expression were observed in four children, but one child in the high-dose group died of treatment-related acute respiratory distress syndrome. On the same day, the US FDA issued a draft BLA guidance for individualised genome-editing products, allowing a new patient-specific variant within an "individualised feature space" to be added without a new clinical trial. Switzerland's Atlas Bio came out of stealth with $12.5 million in total funding, using an AI model trained on about 2 million human RNA datasets to run virtual clinical trials. A Geromedicine study found 17 plasma proteins associated with all-cause mortality and organ biological age in older people. Korea's Jeju Genome Project released a genomic and phenotypic cohort of 5,307 people.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年10月27日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 27 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本期五条要闻集中在“体内基因编辑走向临床”和“AI 重塑药物研发与衰老评估”。上海仁济医院与德国汉诺威医学院合作的体内碱基编辑疗法 SERP-01，单次给药后 4 名 α1-抗胰蛋白酶缺乏症患者的保护性蛋白持续达标；BMS 领投 Pathos AI 2.37 亿美元 E 轮，估值约 30 亿美元；耶鲁团队在 Cell 发表牛磺酸通过抑制 NLRP3 炎症小体减轻“炎性衰老”的机制；中国殷昊团队在 Nature Protocols 发布可精确复制基因组片段的“扩增编辑”标准流程；npj Aging 评论呼吁以“生物年龄 + AI”取代日历年龄指导临床决策。
briefs.summary_en: This edition has five items centred on in vivo gene editing moving into the clinic and on AI reshaping drug development and ageing assessment. SERP-01, an in vivo base-editing therapy developed in a collaboration between Shanghai Renji Hospital and Hannover Medical School, kept protective protein levels above the threshold after a single dose in four patients with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency; Bristol Myers Squibb led a $237 million Series E for Pathos AI at a valuation of about $3 billion; a Yale team reported in Cell a mechanism by which taurine eases "inflammaging" by inhibiting the NLRP3 inflammasome; Hao Yin's team in China published a Nature Protocols standard workflow for amplification editing, which can precisely copy genomic segments; and an npj Aging commentary called for using "biological age + AI" instead of chronological age to guide clinical decisions.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年10月26日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 26 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本期（周一，覆盖上周五至今）五条要闻集中在“更便宜地读懂基因组”和“用 AI 整合多组学”。人类基因组测序先驱 Venter 团队仅用纳米孔单一技术组装出接近端粒到端粒（T2T）的完整二倍体基因组；欧洲团队在 Cancer Cell 用 AI 整合约 2000 例结直肠癌的多组学与单细胞数据找到联合用药方向；英国生物样本库启动 8 万份血样的免疫单细胞画像；中国团队在 Cell Metabolism 发现骨骼受力可延缓全身衰老、让老年小鼠寿命延长 9.4%；ESMO 2026 上，“生物学优先”AI 在不足 70 例的小队列中预测疗效优于传统模型。
briefs.summary_en: This edition (Monday, covering last Friday to today) has five items centred on reading genomes more cheaply and using AI to integrate multi-omics. Genome-sequencing pioneer Craig Venter's team assembled a near telomere-to-telomere (T2T) diploid genome using nanopore sequencing alone; a European team used AI in Cancer Cell to integrate multi-omic and single-cell data from about 2,000 colorectal cancers and identify combination therapies; UK Biobank launched immune single-cell profiling of 80,000 blood samples; a Chinese team reported in Cell Metabolism that mechanical loading of bone delays whole-body ageing and extended the lifespan of old mice by 9.4%; and at ESMO 2026 a "biology-first" AI predicted treatment response better than conventional models in cohorts of fewer than 70 patients.

briefs.title_zh: 量子能生态 RWA周报 · 2026年10月23日
briefs.title_en: Quantum Energy & RWA Weekly Brief · 23 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周量子能源进入“政府资助 + 产业落地验证”阶段：日本 NEDO 第二期选中夏普与 QunaSys，用量子计算评估全固态电池材料；澳大利亚 Swinburne 获 220 万澳元，与 QuantX Labs、西门子开发电网量子时钟。两篇新预印本（固体氧化物电解/燃料电池材料、核聚变等离子体模拟）都给出路线图，但也承认实际量子优势尚未得到证明。RWA 方面，基础设施正在走向生产：卢森堡发行欧洲首只政府 DLT 原生基准债（17 亿欧元），DTCC 公布代币化服务上线细节（首批 25 只证券）；萨尔瓦多一座光伏电站以“剩余现金流收益权”代币募资，最高 2,000 万美元。核聚变方面，马普等离子体物理所与哥伦比亚大学成立 1,330 万美元的跨大西洋研究中心，多家聚变企业参与。
briefs.summary_en: This week quantum energy entered a phase of government funding plus industrial validation: NEDO's second round in Japan selected Sharp and QunaSys to use quantum computing to assess all-solid-state battery materials, and Swinburne in Australia received A$2.2 million to develop a grid quantum clock with QuantX Labs and Siemens. Two new preprints (on solid-oxide electrolysis/fuel-cell materials and fusion-plasma simulation) set out roadmaps, while also acknowledging that a practical quantum advantage has not yet been demonstrated. On the RWA side, infrastructure is moving into production: Luxembourg issued Europe's first government DLT-native benchmark bond (€1.7 billion), DTCC published launch details for its tokenization service (an initial 25 securities), and a solar plant in El Salvador is raising funds with a token on residual cash-flow rights, for up to $20 million. In fusion, the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics and Columbia University have established a $13.3 million transatlantic research centre, with several fusion companies taking part.

briefs.title_zh: 文明大学国际教育周报 · 2026年10月23日
briefs.title_en: Civilization University · International Education Weekly Brief · 23 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 本周国际高等教育有三条主线。第一，跨境办学和区域枢纽加速：新加坡管理大学（SMU）10 月 22 日在深圳开设其首个中国中心并签署 4 份合作备忘录；越南副总理 10 月 20 日欢迎港大经管学院在河内设校区，建议分阶段推进；伯明翰大学与拉各斯大学 10 月 22 日在尼日利亚开设两个联合硕士项目。第二，中瑞、中欧教育合作机制化：瑞士国民院财政委员会 10 月 16 日以 18 比 7 通过 2027 年加入 Erasmus+ 的拨款，国民院全体会议预计 12 月表决；中国—瑞士职业技术教育联盟 10 月 17 日在天津成立，首批 33 家成员单位。第三，AI 与量子正在重塑院系结构和学位体系：北京工业大学 10 月 16 日成立前沿交叉研究院并为量子科技创新中心揭牌；康奈尔大学宣布 2027 年秋季开设两个在线 AI 硕士。与此同时，美国国际学生政策的不确定性仍在加大（OPT 收费提案、CPT 收紧、诉讼待决），而大额捐赠持续流向美国高校。
briefs.summary_en: International higher education this week has three main threads. First, transnational education and regional hubs are accelerating: Singapore Management University (SMU) opened its first China centre in Shenzhen on 22 October and signed four memoranda of understanding; Vietnam's deputy prime minister on 20 October welcomed a HKU Business School campus in Hanoi and suggested a staged approach; the University of Birmingham and the University of Lagos opened two joint master's programmes in Nigeria on 22 October. Second, China–Switzerland and China–Europe education cooperation is being institutionalised: the Finance Committee of the Swiss National Council on 16 October approved 2027 Erasmus+ funding by 18 votes to 7, with a plenary vote expected in December; the China–Switzerland Vocational and Technical Education Alliance was established in Tianjin on 17 October, with 33 founding members. Third, AI and quantum are reshaping faculty structures and degree systems: Beijing University of Technology established a Frontier Interdisciplinary Research Institute on 16 October and inaugurated a Quantum Science and Technology Innovation Centre; Cornell University announced two online AI master's programmes from autumn 2027. At the same time, uncertainty in US international-student policy continues to grow (a proposed OPT fee, tighter CPT rules, pending litigation), while large gifts continue to flow to US universities.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年10月23日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 23 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 基因编辑首次在人体内实现“先导编辑”，从体外细胞走向直接改写体内 DNA；同时，基因组学方法学迎来重要自我校正——Nature Genetics 指出 TWAS 推断效应方向的错误率高达 23%–33%。资本端，AI 驱动的 RNA 药物递送获英国种子轮融资；中国在基因编辑猪异种肝移植上刷新全球存活纪录；日本上市医疗集团启动 DNA 甲基化“生物年龄”检测，长寿检测加速走向消费端。
briefs.summary_en: Prime editing has been carried out inside the human body for the first time, moving from editing cells outside the body to rewriting DNA directly in vivo. At the same time, genomics methodology has had an important self-correction: Nature Genetics reports that TWAS gets the direction of gene effects wrong 23%–33% of the time. On the funding side, AI-driven RNA drug delivery raised a UK seed round; China set a new world survival record for gene-edited pig-to-primate liver xenotransplantation; and a listed Japanese medical group began developing DNA-methylation "biological age" tests as longevity testing moves quickly towards consumers.

briefs.title_zh: 人类生物基因日报 · 2026年10月22日
briefs.title_en: Human Bio-Gene Daily Brief · 22 October 2026
briefs.summary_zh: 过去 24 小时，基因编辑从临床到早期研发都有重要进展：中国瑞风生物 RM001 地中海贫血基因编辑疗法 II 期 28 名受试者全部脱离输血；中国抗衰老新药公司瑞炬完成数亿元 A 轮融资。欧洲方面，IQM 54 量子比特处理器联合 NVIDIA GPU 完成百万原子级蛋白质自剪切量子-经典模拟，Nature Genetics 发布 7 万余人肝脏甘油三酯 GWAS。美国 OpenAI、PerturbAI 与 Scripps 用数千个 AI 智能体挖掘全脑 CRISPR 图谱。整体信号是基因编辑走向规模化临床，量子计算与 AI 开始进入真实生物学问题。
briefs.summary_en: Over the past 24 hours gene editing made important progress from the clinic to early R&D. In China, all 28 participants in the phase II trial of Reforgene's RM001 gene-editing therapy for thalassaemia became transfusion-independent, and the anti-ageing drug developer Ruiju completed a Series A round worth several hundred million yuan. In Europe, an IQM 54-qubit processor working with NVIDIA GPUs completed a million-atom quantum–classical simulation of protein self-cleavage, and Nature Genetics published a liver-triglyceride GWAS of more than 70,000 people. In the US, OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps used thousands of AI agents to mine a whole-brain CRISPR atlas. The overall signal: gene editing is moving towards large-scale clinical use, and quantum computing and AI are starting to tackle real biological problems.
